{
  "summary": "Verify that the rear-view camera image reliably reappears on every shift into reverse, including repeated drive-to-reverse cycling during parking manoeuvres.",
  "rationale": "The narrative describes a repeatable software behaviour: the rear camera displays on the first shift into reverse, but after shifting to drive and back to reverse the image does not return and requires several infotainment touchscreen inputs to restore. This matches a camera-software display-restore defect on the 2025 Polestar 3, and an open recall (25V293000) for the same model/year addresses a rearview camera image that may not display in reverse, citing FMVSS 111 rear visibility non-compliance. No rulebook entry or prior similar case is available, so a standard functional verification of the camera display on repeated reverse engagements is proposed rather than a rulebook-named targeted test. Because loss of the rear camera view while reversing can deprive the driver of rear visibility and create a back-over risk, the case is flagged for human review before any test is booked.",
  "group": "adas",
  "symptoms": [
    "rear view parking camera software is defective",
    "rear parking camera view does not come back up after shifting from drive into reverse",
    "requires several additional touches on the infotainment touchscreen to restore the camera view"
  ],
  "conditions": [
    "shifting from drive back into reverse",
    "repeated reverse engagements during parking adjustments in a parking lot"
  ],
  "fault_codes": [],
  "safety_relevant": true,
  "targeted": false,
  "test_name": "Standard functional check: rear-view camera display on repeated reverse engagements",
  "clues": [
    {"kind": "component_group", "quote": "BACK OVER PREVENTION: SENSING SYSTEM: CAMERA"},
    {"kind": "symptom", "quote": "The rear view parking camera software is defective."},
    {"kind": "symptom", "quote": "the rear parking camera view does NOT come back up"},
    {"kind": "symptom", "quote": "it requires several additional touches on the car's infotainment touchscreen to bring the rear parking camera view back up"},
    {"kind": "condition", "quote": "if you put the car into drive and then back into reverse"},
    {"kind": "condition", "quote": "as if you are making some parking adjustments in a parking lot"}
  ]
}
